hardRules: Record selectedReasons and rejectedReasons for every evaluated candidate.
Reject asset-led families unless at least one source is classified as embed_asset.
Reject dashboard-data unless the scene contains real structured numeric data.
Never embed assets classified as style_reference or context_only.
Do not invent numeric metrics to satisfy dashboard or chart-capable packages.
Reject candidates whose code lines, data series, bullets, headline, or body exceed package contentCapacity.
Use timeline-documentary only for sourced chronology with 3 to 8 dated events.
Keep long narration in subtitle.text or subtitle.segments.
Return the outro to the dominant family unless the dominant family is blocked by content fit.

productionCandidates.selectedReason: Operational terminal or agent workflow content fits the package-backed terminal interface.
rejectedReasons: Reject when imagery is the main subject.
Reject when the scene is emotion-led rather than operational.
Reject when code, command, process, or system structure is absent.

productionCandidates.selectedReason: Technical structure, inspectable labels, code, or evidence can be explained with the package grid.
rejectedReasons: Reject asset-led product hero reveals.
Reject emotion-first quote openers.
Reject lifestyle montage scenes without structured evidence.

productionCandidates.selectedReason: The scene teaches one concept, short routine, list, or comparison within the package density limits.
rejectedReasons: Reject product-first media stages.
Reject live dashboard metrics.
Reject chronology-first documentary storytelling.

productionCandidates.selectedReason: The scene is a hook, quote, chapter reset, or takeaway that should land through type scale and pause.
rejectedReasons: Reject dense dashboards.
Reject code explanations.
Reject asset-led product walkthroughs that require real UI inspection.

productionCandidates.selectedReason: Real structured numeric data and operational status are available for a dashboard-backed scene.
rejectedReasons: Reject when no real structured numeric data is available.
Reject product-first media scenes.
Reject freeform collage scenes without explicit metric ownership.

productionCandidates.selectedReason: Working notes, derivation, checklist, or compact code reasoning fit the package annotation grammar.
rejectedReasons: Reject asset-led product reveals.
Reject metric-heavy monitoring scenes.
Reject full-bleed cinematic hooks.

productionCandidates.selectedReason: An embeddable product or UI asset is available and is central to the scene.
rejectedReasons: Reject when no embed_asset product media is available.
Reject when the requested asset is style_reference only.
Reject third-party logo or screenshot reuse without clearance.

productionCandidates.selectedReason: Embeddable evidence assets can be arranged as a culture-facing montage or recap.
rejectedReasons: Reject when no embeddable assets are available.
Reject proprietary imagery.
Reject more than four simultaneous source captions.

productionCandidates.selectedReason: The scene depends on sourced chronological evidence with enough dated events.
rejectedReasons: Reject fewer than three dated events.
Reject more than eight events without editorial reduction.
Reject unsourced chronology.

intentReasonTemplate.rejected: Intent {intent} did not map to package-backed family {familyId}.

contentFitFilters.selectedReason: Text density fits the package contentCapacity limits.
contentFitFilters.rejectedReason: Text density exceeds package contentCapacity limits.

contentFitFilters.selectedReason: Requested code lines fit the package code capacity.
contentFitFilters.rejectedReason: Requested code lines exceed the package code capacity.

contentFitFilters.selectedReason: Requested data series fit the package data capacity.
contentFitFilters.rejectedReason: Requested data series exceed the package data capacity.

contentFitFilters.selectedReason: Dashboard candidate has real structured numeric data.
contentFitFilters.rejectedReason: dashboard-data requires real structured numeric data.

contentFitFilters.selectedReason: Asset-led candidate has at least one embed_asset source.
contentFitFilters.rejectedReason: Asset-led packages require an embed_asset source.

contentFitFilters.selectedReason: Timeline candidate has sourced chronology with 3 to 8 dated events.
contentFitFilters.rejectedReason: timeline-documentary requires sourced chronology with 3 to 8 dated events.

bridgeTransitions.reason: A technical bridge preserves topic context before switching from large type to dense metrics.
A teaching bridge reframes operational output before showing product media.
A labeled evidence bridge prevents a hard jump from metrics to source montage.
A clean explanatory bridge turns notes into product-facing takeaways.
A structured bridge adds context before moving from media-first product to chronology.

layoutRules.archetypeLibrary: Layout archetype definitions live in design/layout-library/index.json.
rules: No two consecutive scenes may use the same effective layout unless continuity requires the dominant family outro.
A video with 5 or more scenes must use at least 3 distinct layouts.
Scenes with intent hook or takeaway should not use top-title; prefer center-stage, oversized-type, or bottom-statement.

subtitlePolicy.fallback: Split long narration into subtitle.segments and keep cards short.

qaChecks: Director choices use package-backed productionStyleIds only.
Every evaluated candidate records selected or rejected reasons.
Asset-led packages are rejected without embed_asset.
dashboard-data is rejected without real structured numeric data.
Dominant family share is at least 0.5, no more than 4 families are used, and outro returns to dominant family.
